import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def repeat_params(CA, pmin=28, pmax=48, win=None):
    """Find the repeat period p that minimises CA-RMSD between consecutive repeat
    windows, then get twist/rise from the screw decomposition of the superposition."""
    best=None
    for p in range(pmin,pmax+1):
        w = win or p
        n = len(CA)-p-w+1
        if n < 3: continue
        r=[rmsd_after(CA[i:i+w],CA[i+p:i+p+w]) for i in range(n)]
        m=float(np.median(r))
        if best is None or m<best[0]: best=(m,p,w)
    med,p,w = best
    # screw axis from the best-scoring single pair at that period
    n=len(CA)-p-w+1
    i=int(np.argmin([rmsd_after(CA[j:j+w],CA[j+p:j+p+w]) for j in range(n)]))
    P,Q=CA[i:i+w],CA[i+p:i+p+w]
    Pc,Qc=P-P.mean(0),Q-Q.mean(0)
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=Vt.T@D@U.T
    ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(R)-1)/2,-1,1)))
    ev,evec=np.linalg.eig(R)
    ax=np.real(evec[:,np.argmin(np.abs(ev-1))]); ax/=np.linalg.norm(ax)
    t=Q.mean(0)-R@P.mean(0)
    rise=abs(float(ax@t))
    return p, med, ang, rise
